_comment: Machine-readable glossary and style rules for English UI text (Docs/Localization.md). 'en' is the canonical English term; alternatives are separated by ' / '. 'lint' = error|warn|none controls whether Scripts/l10n/l10n.py check requires the term in the English value when the Japanese source contains 'ja' (error: enforced with --strict; warn: advice only). 'forbidden_en' words must not translate this concept (advice). 'forbidden_en_anywhere' must not appear in any English value except in the negations listed in 'forbidden_en_allowed'.

style.capitalization: Title Case for buttons, navigation titles, tab titles, alert titles, menu items, toggle/picker labels and section headers. Sentence case for body text, subtitles, footers, toasts, notifications, VoiceOver labels/hints and placeholders.
style.voice: Calm, warm, plain, second person. Invite, never pressure. No streaks, loss, urgency, scarcity, guilt or judgement. Contractions are fine. Exclamation marks only where the Japanese celebrates (！).

punctuation.。: . (omit at the end of short labels/buttons)

units.dates: system Date.FormatStyle on the Gregorian calendar for month/year buckets

style.numbers: Grouped by locale (1,234). Never interpolate a year as Int (it renders 2,026).
style.plurals: Every counted English noun uses String Catalog plural variations (one/other).

terms.notes: Brand. Never translated or respelled. The share-card wordmark POMOGEM stays as artwork.
One per completed session (or 10 min of Screen Time). Counter: %lld gem/gems (plural). 一粒/ひと粒 → a gem / one gem. Legacy spelling つぶ → gem.
瓶1杯 → a full jar; N杯目 → jar %lld; 瓶へ戻る → Back to Jar. The en-US description still says 'bottle' — integration fixes it.
10 gems → 1 crystal (pr-27 replaces まとまり粒/まとまり). 結晶の芽 → crystal seed; 今週の結晶 → this week's crystal; 結晶の内訳 → Crystal Details.
Legacy noun; pr-27 renames to 結晶. The product site's 'grouped gem' is superseded.
Lifetime time milestone. 'Time Core' in titles. Replaces the English eyebrow TIME CORE.
Weighs 0 g, separate from mass. Matches site/store. 記念石にする → Make a Milestone Stone.
The real-world event (100点, 合格, 仕事の節目). 成果を積む → Add an Achievement; 成果メモ → achievement note; 成果を編集 → Edit Achievement.
pr-36 noun for Screen Time time on apps the user wants to use less (黒いgem legacy). Neutral, never shaming. Store copy currently says 'black gems' — integration aligns it.
pr-36 noun (勉強のgem legacy).

User-defined study/work theme. テーマを管理 → Manage Themes; テーマを選ぶ → Choose a Theme.
Noun and verb. 集中をはじめる/集中を始める → Start Focus (button); 集中する → Focus; 集中中/集中を続けています → Focusing; 集中完了 → Focus Complete.
5分休憩 → 5-Min Break; 休憩をスキップ → Skip Break; ここで休む → Rest Here.
Verb: finish/complete a session. 完走した回数 → completed sessions. Never 'win'.
Gentle stop; not 'Done' (it does not complete the session).
Badge 'Timed'; running text 'timed sessions'. (Site uses 'Measured' — integration may align the site.)
Badge 'Self-reported'. Never implies dishonesty.
時間を手動で積む → Add Time Manually; 確認して積む → Confirm and Add.
積んだ → added; 積み上げ/積み重ね → build up.
Screen title 'Progress'; 積み上がりを見る → See Progress; 積み上がり計画 → Plan Ahead (screen: 'Plan').
Tab/screen 記録 → Log; 記録を見る → View Log; 集中記録 → focus sessions; 記録は削除していません → Your records have not been deleted.
Wrapped. 今月の積み重ね (setting) → Monthly Recap.
年月の棚 → year and month shelf.
pr-27 replaces FOCUS CONSTELLATION.
Pro feature (まとまり粒の月刻印 → month stamps on crystals).
記録の保存先 → where your records are stored.
Matches the product site.
端末 → device; keep 'iPhone' where the Japanese says iPhone.
再集計中 → Recounting…; 確認中 → Checking…
Histories are never merged. 上書き → replace (do not mix 'overwrite').
ユーザー内容を削除 → Delete Your Content; typed confirmation word 削除 → DELETE.
終了通知 → timer-end notification; 毎日のリマインダー → Daily Reminder; 集中に戻るお知らせ → Return-to-Focus Reminder.
カードにする → Make a Card; 本文をコピー → Copy Text; 写真に2サイズ保存 → Save 2 Sizes to Photos.
